THE SIGNAL

WEAR YOUR
OWN FREQUENCY.

AFTRHRS is a streetwear label for self-directed lives. A considered uniform for the in-between: after work, before the world wakes, and every hour you claim for yourself.

We believe personal style has its own rhythm. Our point of view is simple: move with intention, keep your signal clear, and never dress for someone else’s approval.
